title: Data analysis of Velys Knee Robot and the radiographs
summary: During a robotik total knee arthroplasti geometrical and biomechanical data of the knee is stored by the robot. Together with the radiological data of theese knees a classification of subgroups shall be obtained.

interventions.name: Patient undergoing total knee arhroplasty using the Velys robot by JnJ. Subject of this investigation is the analysis of the robotic data and the geometrical data obtained of the pre preoperative radiographs. Additionally PROMS are mesured using 2 scores. FJS and OKS.
